config.scope: Full frozen463 VAL: independent masks, supervised head when enabled, conservative review union; no CAL/test/selection change
config.timing_context: CPU audit may overlap separate GPU training; not an isolated idle latency comparison

classification.score_definition: Independent mask presence, maximum pixel proxy

segmentation.empty_policy: Normals excluded from positive macro Dice/IoU. Missed positive Dice/IoU/recall=0; empty prediction precision=null. Global metrics include normal false-positive pixels.

localization.method: Native predicted connected-component enclosing boxes vs enclosing boxes of individual COCO polygon rasterizations; confidence=max pixel output per component; masks gated at native threshold 0.5; one-to-one, equal-score batching, 101-point interpolated AP. Not canonical COCO mAP or a separately trained detection head.

calibration.interpretation: Uncalibrated review-score diagnostic; no clinical confidence claim
